name: goblin-companion
description: A snarky goblin companion for Codex with native avatar assets and a Windows desktop fallback.

interface.shortDescription: A snarky goblin companion for Codex coding sessions.
interface.longDescription: Goblin Companion provides a native Codex custom avatar asset package plus a transparent Windows desktop fallback for Codex Desktop builds or accounts that do not expose custom avatars yet. It reacts to coding states, shows short reviewer-style comments, supports token feeding, and stays local-first.
defaultPrompt: Launch the Goblin Companion desktop fallback.
Install the Goblin Companion native Codex avatar assets.
